entry.title: New: Bill 3015 (Kauaʻi) — First Reading
entry.content:
For An Ordinance Amending Chapter 8, Kaua‘i County Code 1987, As Amended, Relating to Apiaries And Beekeeping, promoting beekeeping in Kaua‘i County by establishing generally accepted apiary management practices for sound and sustainable beekeeping practices and adding apiaries to the list of allowable uses in various zoning districts.
